verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' own marketing says users can manage everything that happens on corporate cards in real time (docs-34). It also offers analysis by cost centers, users and expense categories (docs-26), with each payment auto-categorized by area, owner and expense type (docs-24); cost centers, categories and suppliers can classify transactions (docs-6, docs-7, docs-8). missing for 10: an explicit per-merchant spend breakdown (only supplier classification is documented), detail on how quickly transactions appear beyond the marketing 'tempo real' claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
